segments.REV.1.4-6: John wishes the churches grace and praises Jesus Christ
segments.REV.1.7-8: Jesus will come and God says he is the Almighty
segments.REV.1.9-11: On Patmos, John is told to write to seven churches
segments.REV.1.12-13: John sees One like the Son of Man among lampstands
segments.REV.1.14-16: John describes the glorious appearance of the Son of Man
segments.REV.1.17-18: Jesus tells John not to fear because he lives forever
segments.REV.1.19-20: Jesus explains the seven stars and seven lampstands
segments.REV.2.1-2: Jesus praises the Ephesians for testing false apostles
segments.REV.2.3-5: Jesus warns the Ephesians to repent and love as at first
segments.REV.2.6-7: Jesus promises the tree of life to believers who overcome
segments.REV.2.8-9: Jesus knows the suffering of the church in Smyrna
segments.REV.2.10-11: Jesus tells the Smyrnans to be faithful until death
segments.REV.2.12-13: Jesus praises believers in Pergamum for staying faithful
segments.REV.2.14-15: Jesus warns Pergamum believers about false teaching
segments.REV.2.16-17: Jesus tells Pergamum to repent and promises hidden manna
segments.REV.2.18-19: Jesus praises the love, faith and service of Thyatira
segments.REV.2.20-21: Jesus rebukes Thyatira for tolerating Jezebel’s teaching
segments.REV.2.22-23: Jesus says he will punish Jezebel and those who follow her
segments.REV.2.24-25: Jesus tells faithful believers in Thyatira to hold on
segments.REV.2.26-29: Jesus promises authority to believers who overcome
segments.REV.3.1-2: Jesus tells the church in Sardis to wake up
segments.REV.3.3-4: Jesus warns Sardis to repent but praises a faithful few
segments.REV.3.5-6: Jesus promises believers who overcome will wear white
segments.REV.3.7-8: Jesus gives Philadelphia believers an open door
segments.REV.3.9-11: Jesus promises to keep believers from the hour of testing
segments.REV.3.14-16: Jesus rebukes the Laodiceans for being lukewarm
segments.REV.3.17-18: Jesus says the Laodiceans are poor and blind, not rich
segments.REV.3.19-20: Jesus knocks at the door and calls the Laodiceans to repent
segments.REV.3.21-22: Jesus promises believers who overcome a seat on his throne
segments.REV.4.1-3: John is called up to heaven and sees God on a throne
segments.REV.4.4-4: John sees twenty-four elders with gold crowns on thrones
segments.REV.4.6-6: John sees a sea of glass and four living creatures
segments.REV.4.7-8: The four living creatures never stop praising God as holy
segments.REV.4.9-11: The elders worship God and praise him as Creator
segments.REV.5.1-2: John sees a sealed scroll; an angel asks who is worthy
segments.REV.5.3-5: No one can open the scroll, but the Lion of Judah can
segments.REV.5.6-7: The Lamb takes the scroll from the One on the throne
segments.REV.5.8-8: The creatures and elders fall down before the Lamb
segments.REV.5.9-10: A new song praises the Lamb for buying people for God
segments.REV.5.11-12: Many angels say the Lamb is worthy to receive honor
segments.REV.5.13-14: All creatures praise God and the Lamb; the elders worship
segments.REV.6.12-14: The sixth seal brings an earthquake and signs in the sky
segments.REV.6.15-17: People of every rank hide from the wrath of the Lamb
segments.REV.7.1-3: Angels hold back the winds until God’s servants are sealed
segments.REV.7.4-6: 12,000 are sealed from each of six tribes of Israel
segments.REV.7.7-8: 12,000 are sealed from each of six more tribes
segments.REV.7.9-10: A great multitude in white robes praises God and the Lamb
segments.REV.7.11-12: The angels fall facedown and worship God
segments.REV.7.13-14: An elder explains who the people in white robes are
segments.REV.7.15-17: God will protect and comfort the people in white robes
segments.REV.8.1-2: The seventh seal brings silence; seven angels get trumpets
segments.REV.8.3-5: An angel offers prayers with incense and throws fire down
segments.REV.8.6-7: The first trumpet brings hail and fire on the earth
segments.REV.8.8-9: The second trumpet turns a third of the sea to blood
segments.REV.8.10-11: The third trumpet makes a third of the waters bitter
segments.REV.8.12-12: The fourth trumpet darkens a third of sun, moon and stars
segments.REV.8.13-13: An eagle cries woe to those who live on the earth
segments.REV.9.1-2: The fifth trumpet: a star opens the pit and smoke rises
segments.REV.9.3-4: Locusts with scorpion power may harm only unsealed people
segments.REV.9.5-6: The locusts torment people for five months
segments.REV.9.7-9: The locusts look like horses ready for battle
segments.REV.9.10-12: The locusts have scorpion tails and a king, Abaddon
segments.REV.9.13-15: The sixth angel blows his trumpet and four angels are freed
segments.REV.9.16-17: John sees a huge army of horses and riders
segments.REV.9.18-19: Plagues from the horses kill a third of people
segments.REV.9.20-21: The people left alive still do not turn from their sins
segments.REV.10.1-2: John sees a mighty angel with a small open scroll
segments.REV.10.3-4: Seven thunders speak, but John must not write it down
segments.REV.10.5-7: The angel swears that God’s mystery will soon be fulfilled
segments.REV.10.8-9: John is told to take the scroll and eat it
segments.REV.10.10-11: John eats the scroll and must prophesy again
segments.REV.11.1-2: John must measure the temple, but not the courtyard
segments.REV.11.3-5: God sends two witnesses to prophesy for 1,260 days
segments.REV.11.6-6: The two witnesses have power to stop rain and send plagues
segments.REV.11.7-7: The beast fights the two witnesses and kills them
segments.REV.11.8-9: The bodies of the two witnesses lie in the street
segments.REV.11.10-12: The two witnesses live again and go up to heaven
segments.REV.11.13-14: An earthquake strikes the city and the survivors praise God
segments.REV.11.15-15: The seventh angel blows his trumpet and voices praise God
segments.REV.11.16-17: The twenty-four elders worship God and thank him
segments.REV.11.18-18: The elders say the time has come for God to judge
segments.REV.11.19-19: God’s temple in heaven opens and the ark appears
segments.REV.12.1-2: John sees a woman in heaven about to give birth
segments.REV.12.3-4: A huge red dragon waits to devour the woman’s child
segments.REV.12.5-6: The woman’s son is taken to God and she flees
segments.REV.12.10-10: A voice in heaven says God’s kingdom has come
segments.REV.12.13-14: The dragon chases the woman, but she flies away
segments.REV.12.15-18: The dragon attacks the woman and makes war on her children
segments.REV.13.1-2: A beast with ten horns and seven heads rises from the sea
segments.REV.13.3-4: The whole world follows and worships the beast
segments.REV.13.5-6: The beast speaks evil against God for 42 months
segments.REV.13.7-8: The beast fights the saints and many people worship it
segments.REV.13.9-10: John calls believers to stay faithful and patient
segments.REV.13.11-12: A second beast makes people worship the first beast
segments.REV.13.13-14: The second beast does signs and deceives people
segments.REV.13.16-17: The second beast forces all people to take a mark
segments.REV.13.18-18: John asks wise people to work out the number 666
segments.REV.14.1-2: John sees the Lamb and 144,000 on Mount Zion
segments.REV.14.3-5: The 144,000 sing a new song before God’s throne
segments.REV.14.6-7: An angel tells all people to fear and worship God
segments.REV.14.8-8: A second angel says Babylon has fallen
segments.REV.14.9-10: A third angel warns those who worship the beast
segments.REV.14.11-12: Beast worshipers have no rest; believers must endure
segments.REV.14.13-13: A voice says those who die in the Lord are blessed
segments.REV.14.14-16: One like the Son of Man harvests the earth
segments.REV.14.17-18: An angel tells another angel to gather the grapes
segments.REV.14.19-20: The angel throws the earth’s grapes into God’s winepress
segments.REV.15.1-1: John sees seven angels with the seven last plagues
segments.REV.15.2-2: Those who beat the beast stand by a sea of glass
segments.REV.15.3-4: The victors sing the song of Moses and the Lamb
segments.REV.15.5-6: The seven angels come out of the temple in heaven
segments.REV.15.7-8: The seven angels receive bowls full of God’s wrath
segments.REV.16.1-1: A voice tells the seven angels to pour out the bowls
segments.REV.16.2-2: The first bowl brings sores on the beast’s followers
segments.REV.16.3-3: The second bowl turns the sea to blood
segments.REV.16.8-9: The fourth bowl burns people, but they do not repent
segments.REV.16.10-11: The fifth bowl brings darkness, and people still curse God
segments.REV.16.15-16: Jesus says he comes like a thief; kings gather at Armageddon
segments.REV.16.20-21: Islands and mountains vanish; people curse God for the hail
segments.REV.17.3-5: John sees a woman sitting on a scarlet beast
segments.REV.17.6-7: The angel will explain the woman and the beast to John
segments.REV.17.8-8: The beast will rise from the Abyss and then be destroyed
segments.REV.17.9-10: The seven heads are seven mountains and seven kings
segments.REV.17.11-11: The beast is an eighth king who goes to destruction
segments.REV.17.12-13: The ten horns are ten kings who give power to the beast
segments.REV.17.14-14: The Lamb will defeat those who make war against him
segments.REV.17.15-15: The angel says the waters are peoples and nations
segments.REV.17.16-17: The beast and the ten kings will destroy the prostitute
segments.REV.17.18-18: The woman is the great city that rules the kings
segments.REV.18.1-3: An angel announces that Babylon the great has fallen
segments.REV.18.4-6: A voice from heaven tells God’s people to leave Babylon
segments.REV.18.7-8: Babylon will suffer grief and fire in one day
segments.REV.18.9-10: The kings of the earth weep over Babylon’s fall
segments.REV.18.11-13: The merchants weep because no one is left to buy cargo
segments.REV.18.14-14: The merchants say Babylon’s luxury is gone forever
segments.REV.18.15-17: The merchants mourn that the city’s wealth is destroyed
segments.REV.18.18-20: Sailors mourn the city and heaven is told to rejoice
segments.REV.18.21-22: An angel throws a stone to show Babylon will fall
segments.REV.18.23-24: Babylon loses light and joy because it killed God’s people
segments.REV.19.1-2: A great crowd in heaven praises God for his judgments
segments.REV.19.3-4: The elders and living creatures worship God
segments.REV.19.5-5: A voice from the throne tells God’s servants to praise him
segments.REV.19.6-6: A great crowd praises God because the Lord reigns
segments.REV.19.7-8: The crowd says the Lamb’s marriage has come
segments.REV.19.11-13: John sees Faithful and True riding a white horse
segments.REV.19.14-16: The armies of heaven follow the King of kings
segments.REV.19.17-18: An angel calls the birds to eat at God’s great supper
segments.REV.19.19-20: The beast and the false prophet are thrown into fire
segments.REV.19.21-21: The rider’s sword kills the rest, and birds eat the flesh
segments.REV.20.1-3: An angel binds Satan in the Abyss for a thousand years
segments.REV.20.4-4: Believers who were killed reign with Christ for 1,000 years
segments.REV.20.5-6: Those in the first resurrection are blessed and holy
segments.REV.20.7-8: Satan is released and gathers the nations for battle
segments.REV.20.11-12: The dead stand before the great white throne to be judged
segments.REV.20.13-15: People not in the Book of Life are thrown into the fire
segments.REV.21.1-2: John sees a new heaven, a new earth and the new Jerusalem
segments.REV.21.3-4: God will live with his people and wipe away every tear
segments.REV.21.5-6: God makes all things new and offers the water of life
segments.REV.21.7-8: Those who overcome inherit all; the wicked are punished
segments.REV.21.9-10: An angel shows John the holy city, the bride of the Lamb
segments.REV.21.11-13: The city shines with God’s glory and has twelve gates
segments.REV.21.16-17: The city’s length, width and height are all equal
segments.REV.21.18-20: The city is pure gold, and its foundations are jewels
segments.REV.21.21-22: The gates are pearls, and God and the Lamb are the temple
segments.REV.21.23-25: God’s glory lights the city, and the gates never close
segments.REV.21.26-27: Only people written in the Book of Life enter the city
segments.REV.22.3-5: God’s servants will see his face and reign forever
segments.REV.22.6-7: The angel says these words are true; Jesus is coming soon
segments.REV.22.8-9: The angel tells John to worship God, not the angel
segments.REV.22.10-11: The angel tells John not to seal the words of prophecy
segments.REV.22.12-13: Jesus says he is coming soon to reward each person
segments.REV.22.14-15: Those with washed robes enter; the wicked stay outside
segments.REV.22.16-16: Jesus says he sent his angel to the churches
segments.REV.22.17-17: The Spirit and the bride invite the thirsty to come
segments.REV.22.18-19: God will punish anyone who changes the words of this book
segments.REV.22.20-21: Jesus says he is coming soon; grace be with all believers
